title: Prometheus alerts on a waiting gate, a stalled run and a failed run, and sends them to a local Alertmanager
goal: kbmon --metrics gives the points a rule needs (items by run state, the seconds the oldest blocked item has waited, the seconds since the newest progress event of a working item, failed runs); otel/kbmon.rules.yml adds KbmonGateWaiting, KbmonRunStalled and KbmonRunFailed over them, which --check-rules proves against /metrics; otel/prometheus.yml sends firing alerts to an Alertmanager on loopback and otel/alertmanager.yml routes them to the receiver the operator chose, with no credential in the file

run:
import os, re, sys
rules = open('otel/kbmon.rules.yml', encoding='utf-8').read()
prom = open('otel/prometheus.yml', encoding='utf-8').read()
names = {n for n in ('KbmonGateWaiting', 'KbmonRunStalled', 'KbmonRunFailed') if re.search(r'alert:\s*' + n + r'\b', rules)}
alerting = re.search(r'^alerting:\s*\n(?:\s+.*\n)*?\s+-?\s*targets:\s*\[\s*"127\.0\.0\.1:\d+"\s*\]', prom, re.M)
am = os.path.exists('otel/alertmanager.yml') and 'receivers:' in open('otel/alertmanager.yml', encoding='utf-8').read()
print('rules', sorted(names), '| alerting to loopback', bool(alerting), '| alertmanager.yml', am)
sys.exit(0 if len(names) == 3 and alerting and am else 1)

gates.question: Where does the local Alertmanager send a firing alert?
options: a loopback webhook receiver in the standard library that posts each alert as a coord ask to operator, which kbmon shows
email to an address the operator sets outside the repository
a chat or phone service the operator names, its credential kept outside the repository
gates.recommendation: a loopback webhook receiver in the standard library that posts each alert as a coord ask to operator, which kbmon shows
gates.answer: a loopback webhook receiver in the standard library that posts each alert as a coord ask to operator, which kbmon shows

notes: Premise: otel/kbmon.rules.yml holds three rules on the kb's health (eval, any alert, an orphan) and none on a sprint run; otel/prometheus.yml has no alerting block and the repository no Alertmanager config (the check prints rules [], alerting False, alertmanager.yml False). Prometheus only evaluates alerts; notifying is a separate Alertmanager (kb/public/logs/prometheus-retention-exposition.md:55, DOC). As for Prometheus itself, the operator installs Alertmanager outside the clone; the repository holds config files only.
